field: Postgraduate study in any field of importance to New Zealand
qualifications: At least five years' residence in New Zealand immediately before the year of selection (at least 1,350 days over five years and 240 days in each year)
For postgraduate study in New Zealand or overseas
Applications open 1 October and close 1 February
description_short: Universities New Zealand's William Georgetti Scholarship supports postgraduate study by long-term New Zealand residents, in New Zealand or overseas. Awards reach NZ$30,000 a year for doctoral study in New Zealand. Applications close 1 February.

compensation.value: Up to NZ$20,000 a year (Masters in NZ), NZ$30,000 a year (doctoral in NZ), up to NZ$45,000 a year overseas
compensation.evidence_quote: In New Zealand up to $20,000 per year for Masters study and $30,000 per year for doctoral study. For those students studying overseas, the award can be up to $NZ45,000 per year.
